title: Wool Omnibus
author: Hugh Howey
note: conf=0.95; All proposed fields were null and are corrected. The file is the Wool Omnibus (collecting the five self-published Wool novellas: Holston, Proper Gauge, Casting Off, The Unraveling, The Stranded), by Hugh Howey (EPUB metadata gives surname only). Goodreads catalogues Wool Omnibus as Silo #1 (Broad Reach Publishing, 25 Jan 2012); the Silo series continues with Shift (#2) and Dust (#3). The novella-level "Wool" sequence (Wool 1-5) is subsumed by this omnibus, so Silo is the appropriate series with number 1. No ISBN in file, consistent with early self-published ebook editions.
